subject: Your order, and how to get the most from it
headline: Thanks for choosing Vanta
body:
A few things worth knowing now that your order is on its way or has arrived.

Your batch: the certificate of analysis for each product is in the COA library, matched to the batch number on your vial.

Storage: keep lyophilized vials sealed, dry and away from light until use. Details are on each product page.

Questions: reply to this email. A member of the team answers every message.

This is research material, supplied for laboratory research use only.
